title: The Failsafe
text: "If you're hearing this, they've used it. I'm sorry. I built it to be gentle, and I built it so that it would not need you to agree. I hope it was the right call. I'm nearly always sorry about the things I make."

lines.text: "It's in the hydroponics bay. It's a lever. It's just a lever." A breath. "They've voted. I'm sorry. I didn't vote for it, but I won't stop them."

choices.label: Let them
choices.reply: You do not fight the lever. It would be very easy to.

notes: Autonomist-led (failsafe-built and acceptance ≤ 45): Bede's recorded message plays when the failsafe is thrown.
